Given SOP 263, computer DEV-W11-01 (computerId=1), stored Local script 1, When an agent calls immybot_scripts_run(scriptId=1, computerId=1, confirm=true) against the live mspbotsai.immy.bot instance, Then the call does not return HTTP 400 and the output contains TEST-VPN-OK DEV-W11-01.

Call immybot_scripts_run with scriptId=1, computerId=1, databaseType=Local, runAs=System, timeout=90, confirm=true

text: Given the same Recorder stub as TC1, When immybot_scripts_run is called first with confirm omitted and then with confirm=true, Then neither the preview dict nor the final result contains the script's action text (only id/name/computer/status/output fields).

Given a Recorder stub for scripts/global/<id> (local lookup 404s) and POST scripts/run, When immybot_scripts_run(scriptId=<id>, computerId=<n>, confirm=true, databaseType=Global) is called, Then the request succeeds the same way as the Local case in TC1.

Given two back-to-back confirmed calls with the same scriptId/computerId, When both outbound requests are inspected, Then their cancellationId values differ.

Given the tool's registered description (as returned by tools/list), When it is read, Then it states that immybot_scripts_get is optional for a script id already approved by an administrator or a pre-reviewed workflow, while the confirm: true requirement remains stated.
steps: Start the server locally (or inspect the docstring of immybot_scripts_run in src/immybot_mcp/tools/scripts.py)
Call tools/list and read the description for immybot_scripts_run
expect: Description still requires confirm: true, and additionally states immybot_scripts_get is optional for an already-approved script id
evidence: record the tools/list description text (or the docstring diff) once implemented
